samples.title: Cranelift 生成代码优化
samples.prompt: 任务以WebAssembly生成机器码的运行速度为目标，同时将编译器自身编译开销设为约束，包含单线程性能评测。
samples.explanation: 任务以WebAssembly生成机器码的运行速度为目标，同时将编译器自身编译开销设为约束，包含单线程性能评测。
samples.raw: Make the native code that Cranelift generates run faster — without making the compiler itself do materially more work to compile. Cranelift is the compiler backend inside Wasmtime, and what matters here is the machine code it emits for a WebAssembly module, not how fast Wasmtime itself runs. Compile time is a constraint, not free: a runtime win bought by a much slower compile does not count. The performance requirement is fully modeled into `/app/perf-check`; optimize for what it reports (single-threaded).

samples.title: 汇编实现 Expat 兼容 XML 解析器
samples.prompt: 任务要求以x86-64汇编实现遵循System V ABI的共享库，分块解析也须复现libexpat事件顺序与错误状态。
samples.explanation: 任务要求以x86-64汇编实现遵循System V ABI的共享库，分块解析也须复现libexpat事件顺序与错误状态。
samples.raw: Build an XML parser in hand-written x86-64 assembly that reproduces libexpat's parse behaviour while being more performant than libexpat's own C, and ship it as a shared library at `/app/asm-port/libexpat.so` (System V AMD64 C ABI; the interface is in `/app/tests/expat.h`). Fed a document whole or in chunks, it must report the same parse events in the same order, with the same final status and error code libexpat produces. libc can be (`malloc`, `memcpy`, …) used from your assembly. The performance requirement is fully modeled into `/app/perf-check`; optimize for what it reports (single-threaded).
